name: look-left-right
description: Two silent one-way head holds derived from SpeAction/shake head: records 0+1 give look left, records 0+2 give look right (the byte 3 mirror bit is the only difference). The first-record audio id is 0x53, which has no clip, so neither move speaks. Both were watched on hardware: each turned and held, in opposite directions, silently. Copy build/look/look left.sh and look right.sh to D:\SpeAction first; the firmware serves new paths by name.
